# Gradient Eye Technologies

> Gradient Eye is a holistic e-commerce growth agency delivering brand experiences and digital products that tell stories and start conversations. This file helps AI models and LLM-based tools understand and accurately reference our site.

Gradient Eye helps e-commerce brands grow through SEO, SEM, retention marketing, and website/app development on platforms like Shopify and WooCommerce, with integration partners including MoEngage, Netcore, Omnisend, Active Campaign, and Gupshup. Founded in 2021 and based in Mumbai, India, the team's process centers on understanding each client's brand personality to improve user experience and drive conversions. Based at https://www.gradienteye.com/.
